attributes.abstract: Computing device (101), method and computer program product for replicating a three-dimensional label mask for a three-dimensional volume dataset (190) in a network (100) of computing devices. The device (101) receives a series of segmentation input data from a further computing device (102) of the network describing an editing (2-1) of the label mask on the further computing device (102). The grip component includes a driving unit and a control unit arranged therein, where the driving unit is configured to output an initial motion in response to one or more control signals sent by the control unit.
